{{Top|leg}}
The '''Talking Bone''' was a [[tyrossum]] jaw bone used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of the [[Rock Council]] to signify who had the right to speak at the council. If another being wanted to speak, they had to fight whoever had the bone for the right to speak. During the fight the two participants could not use weapons, claws or [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as learned by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] after using the Force to defeat [[Tojjelnoot]] who had the bone before her.
